move_empty: No movement steps; deploy at the starting position.
move_scope: FE8 REDA steps use absolute destinations. Lines join encoded targets; terrain routing and landing adjustments are determined by the game. Click overlapping nodes repeatedly to cycle. Editing uses at most 16 steps and preserves unused bits.
move_sync_help: Character 0 starts without synchronization. Otherwise wait until that character has no active movement, or has completed the zero-based step index. 65535 waits for its whole movement to end. This does not change the destination coordinates.
move_config_help: Native six-bit movement configuration. 0 uses the engine's default speed; other values are interpreted by the engine. Reserved bits in the same word are preserved.
move_delay_help: Delay before this step, stored in 16 bits. The engine uses a signed 16-bit timer and may wrap high-bit values; use 0–32767 for ordinary delays. Existing high-bit encodings are preserved.
move_limit: This path exceeds the native 16-step buffer. Original data can be preserved; edited paths must be reduced to at most 16 steps before applying.
script_scope: Bounded static instruction listing; scripts, branches and ASM are not executed. Each entry identifies its pointer site. Empty chapter entries can be created explicitly.
script_partial: The instruction boundary or ending could not be confirmed. This partial listing is read-only.
script_opaque: This script includes read-only instructions. Confirmed parameters can be patched at their original addresses; structural editing is unavailable.
script_readonly_instruction: Uninterpreted instruction: original bytes are retained and this row is read-only.
script_operand_help: Decimal and 0x-prefixed values are accepted. Pointer operands use native GBA addresses (0x08000000 plus the ROM offset). Only confirmed operands are writable; unrelated bytes are preserved.
script_reference_help: Follow a confirmed ROM reference. Apply pending script edits before opening its script or deployment pointer site.
script_patch_scope: Patch confirmed parameters at their original addresses. All shared and interior entries observe these bytes; known affected entries are listed below. Unrecognized references may also be affected.
script_relocate_scope: Append the complete known script and update this pointer site. Known internal calls are retargeted. Other pointer sites retain the original script and bytes.
game_invalid_script: Invalid script, label or reference. Check the instruction sequence and operands.
game_unsupported_script_structure: This script cannot be structurally edited or relocated safely. Unknown, dynamic or incomplete instructions require preserving the original layout.
deploy_scope: Chapter tables and static references in opening, turn, area, objective and talk events. Conditions are not executed. Marks show record numbers. FE8 movement synchronization does not change absolute destinations.
deploy_empty: This entry is empty. Add a unit to create a deployment group.
deploy_stale: The ROM or table layout changed. This draft is preserved; discard it and reload before applying.
deploy_preview_scope: Append deployment data and update the selected pointer site. Other pointers keep their existing data. Chapters sharing this site are affected; known uses are listed below. Other event references have not been exhaustively indexed.
deploy_position_help: Faction: 0 player, 1 ally, 2 enemy, 3 reserved. Autolevel: 0 off, 1 on. Class 0 inherits the character's class. FE8 end coordinates edit the last movement step, preserving earlier steps and other path bytes.
deploy_pick_help: Click to select a unit; repeat to cycle stacked units. Select an empty cell, then use the position buttons to move the selected unit.
deploy_no_selection: Select a unit to edit its properties.
game_invalid_deployment: The deployment entry, records or movement data could not be read. Other entries remain editable.
game_incomplete_deployment_script: Some event references could not be resolved statically. Available entries remain editable.
fault_exists: The requested path already exists. Check its contents or choose a different location.
fault_not_found: The file or directory was not found. Check its location and choose it again.
fault_permission: Access was denied. Check file permissions or choose a writable location.
fault_io: The file operation failed. Check the diagnostic details, disk space and destination before trying again.
map_choose_cell: Click to select a cell; drag or scroll to pan.
map_preview_scope: Static base map before fog, animations and event changes. The deployment view overlays the selected group’s record numbers.
map_resource_error: Cannot read {resource}. Check its resource ID or data; chapter configuration remains editable.
game_invalid_map: The map resources or layout could not be read. Chapter configuration remains editable.
chapter_objective_help: Only changes the displayed objective. Events determine the actual victory condition.
portrait_colors: Up to 15 opaque colours plus transparency. The preview shows the resulting GBA colours.
asset_edit_summary: {count} known fields reference this asset ID. Other uses of the same ID also change.
game_unsupported_asset_format: This portrait uses an extension whose full sheet cannot yet be imported or exported. Its existing preview remains available.
game_invalid_asset_size: Choose a PNG of at most 1 MiB matching the exported asset: 16×16 for icons, 128×112 for standard portrait sheets, or the original class-card size.
game_invalid_asset_colors: Icons must use the current shared palette. Portraits allow up to 15 opaque colours plus transparency. Partial transparency is unsupported.
game_unmapped_asset_pixels: Unused portrait-sheet areas have no storage location. Keep them transparent and follow the exported sheet layout.
png_export_rom: A PNG export cannot overwrite an open ROM.
field_hint: Select a value to adjust. Tab moves between fields; ↑↓ changes the value.
game_invalid_image: The image address or format could not be read. Other fields remain editable.
layout_scope: Applies to this window only; ROM pointers stay unchanged. Address and record size must be aligned to 4 bytes.
move_table_scope: Copy the automatically located table and update confirmed references. The original data stays in place. Apply creates one undoable edit; save writes the file.
space_invalid_range: The declared free space is invalid or overlaps protected data. No changes were applied.
space_no_capacity: This operation would exceed the 32 MiB ROM limit.
space_invalid_reference: A confirmed reference no longer points to the source, or no reference could be confirmed. No changes were applied.
invalid_address: Enter a hexadecimal ROM offset or a GBA ROM address starting with 08 or 09.
batch_scope: Choose a field and preview the changes before applying them to the records below. Changing the search clears selection.
text_control_help: Use the commands below or their raw [0xNNNN] forms. LoadFace takes one 16-bit parameter, for example [LoadFace][0x0101]. Newlines can be entered directly or as [NL]. Availability also depends on the ROM’s Huffman tree.
text_draft_stale: This text changed in the ROM. Your draft is preserved. Copy any changes you need, then discard the draft and reload before applying.
game_unsupported_text_control: This command is unknown or unavailable for this version. Unknown ROM controls are retained for inspection and remain read-only.
game_invalid_text_argument: A control parameter is incomplete or unsupported. LoadFace requires one [0xNNNN] parameter with a nonzero low byte; the parameter must be encodable by this ROM.
hex_scope: Read a byte range, then apply the edited bytes to the in-memory ROM as one undoable operation. Save to write the file.
invalid_hex: Enter two hex digits per byte, separated by spaces or newlines. The byte count must match the range read.
raw_length: Read between 1 and 4096 bytes at a time.
raw_read_first: Read the chosen address and length before applying edits.
raw_stale: The ROM changed. Your draft is preserved; copy any edits you need and read the range again before applying.
no_emulator: mGBA was not found. Install an emulator or set FEBUILDER_EMULATOR to its executable path.
empty_detail: Open an FE6, FE7J, FE7U, FE8J, or FE8U ROM from the File menu. Each file opens in its own window.
name: Name
name_edit_scope: English ROMs use ASCII; Japanese ROMs use Shift-JIS. Characters must be supported by this ROM.
name_needs_id: Choose an existing nonzero name text ID before editing its text.
text_edit_summary: Text ID {textID}: all uses of this ID will change. Known text fields: {count}.
game_invalid_name_encoding: This name cannot be encoded with the ROM's character encoding and Huffman tree. Use supported characters without leading or trailing spaces; game text must fit 4096 bytes.
description_edit_scope: English ROMs use ASCII; Japanese ROMs use Shift-JIS. Use readable commands such as [A], [Wink] and [LoadFace][0x0101], or raw control markers. [.] is padding. Escape literal [ and backslash as \[ and \\.
game_invalid_text_encoding: This text cannot be encoded losslessly. Use characters, commands and parameters supported by the ROM’s encoding and Huffman tree. Game text must fit 4096 bytes.
game_invalid_text: The text entry or Huffman tree is invalid. Writing requires a valid primary text-table pointer.
external: The ROM changed on disk. Reload it or save as another file.
text_error: The name could not be decoded; its text ID remains editable.
run_saved: Save your changes before starting the emulator.
error: The operation failed. See the details.
game_unsupported_version: This version supports FE6, FE7J, FE7U, FE8J, and FE8U. Choose a valid ROM for one of these games.
game_invalid_layout: This table's location or extent could not be determined. Other tables remain available.
game_invalid_value: The value is outside this field's range.
game_invalid_field: The record or field could not be found.
rom_range: The edits are out of range or overlap. No changes were applied.
rom_stale_edit: The document changed. Read the data again or select the record before editing.
rom_external_change: The file changed on disk. Reload it or save as another file.
rom_target_exists: The target exists. Choose another path or confirm replacement.
rom_read_only: The file is read-only. Save it to a writable location.
rom_invalid_size: Invalid file size. A ROM must be a regular file of at most 32 MiB.
record_estimate_range: Use a valid level at or above the initial level, or 0–255 class growths.
record_default_class_help: Default and reference class. Chapter deployments can override it. Reference abilities use this class, rather than actual game state.
record_related_class_help: Related class in this native record. In FE8, promoted autoleveling uses it as the lower-tier class reference; promotion branches are defined separately.
record_estimate_help: Reference only: current class base plus character modifiers, then growth rate × growth count / 100. Class estimates use class growths. Excludes caps, promotions, random levels, difficulty bonuses and event changes. Reference settings do not write ROM or create history.
record_weapons_help: Exact stored weapon EXP is retained. Character zero inherits the referenced class; a nonzero value replaces it. A changed rank writes its native minimum; choosing the same rank keeps partial progress. FE6 thresholds differ from FE7/FE8.
record_traits_help: Each checkbox edits this record's bit only. Character and deployment-class traits combine in game. Unknown bits remain read-only here; raw encoding is available under advanced data.
trait_mounted_aid_help: Uses the mounted aid calculation for rescue.
trait_canto_help: Allows unused movement after applicable non-attack actions.
trait_thief_help: Enables thief-related rules such as fog vision and lockpick access.
trait_dance_help: Enables Dance; animation and map sprite requirements still apply.
trait_play_help: Enables Play; animation and map sprite requirements still apply.
trait_critical_help: Enables the native critical bonus (15% in FE7/FE8).
trait_promoted_help: Affects promoted experience and weapon-rank rules.
trait_supply_help: Transport behavior varies by version; FE8 retains an unused transport flag with preparation effects.
trait_cavalry_icon_help: Sets the cavalry classification/icon; this alone does not define a movement-cost table.
trait_wyvern_icon_help: Sets wyvern classification/icon; movement and other rules remain version-specific.
trait_pegasus_icon_help: Sets pegasus classification/icon; movement and other rules remain version-specific.
trait_lord_help: Marks a lord; chapter and engine rules still determine available commands.
trait_female_help: Sets the native female attribute, including its use in aid calculation.
trait_boss_help: Enables boss classification, marker and applicable experience rules.
trait_weapon_lock_1_help: Allows weapons assigned to native weapon lock 1.
trait_monster_lock_help: Allows the native monster weapon lock.
trait_dragon_lock_help: Allows the native dragonstone weapon lock.
trait_max_level_10_help: FE8 native level-cap flag used by trainee classes.
trait_unselectable_help: Prevents unit selection where the native rule applies.
trait_triangle_pegasus_help: Enables participation in the first native triangle attack.
trait_triangle_armor_help: Enables participation in the second native triangle attack.
trait_unknown_help: The version's meaning is not confirmed; preserved during structured edits.
trait_no_experience_help: Applies native experience suppression and related version-specific combat rules.
trait_lethality_help: Enables the native lethality behavior where supported.
trait_magic_seal_help: Enables the native enemy magic-seal effect.
trait_summon_help: FE8 Summon also requires matching summon data.
trait_drop_item_help: FE7 marks the appropriate inventory item for dropping on defeat.
trait_morph_help: FE7 native morph classification; effect depends on engine context.
trait_roy_lock_help: Allows weapons assigned to Roy's native lock.
trait_zephiel_lock_help: Allows weapons assigned to Zephiel's native lock.
trait_eirika_lock_help: Allows weapons assigned to Eirika's native lock.
trait_ephraim_lock_help: Allows weapons assigned to Ephraim's native lock.
trait_eliwood_lock_help: Allows weapons assigned to Eliwood's native lock.
trait_hector_lock_help: Allows weapons assigned to Hector's native lock.
trait_lyn_lock_help: Allows the Lyn lock; unused by default in FE8.
trait_athos_lock_help: Allows the Athos lock; unused by default in FE8.
portrait_search: Search portrait ID or record name
portrait_no_known_uses: No known character or class references
batch_title: Batch edit — {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}
turn_existing_script: The existing event script is preserved. Open a deployment to edit its units separately.
turn_opaque: This condition kind is preserved as raw data. It can be removed; its fields are read-only.
turn_scope: Edit native turn conditions without executing conditions or ASM. Unresolved events keep their original scripts. New conditions, load scripts and units are applied together.
turn_condition_help: Last turn 0 means the first turn only; FF means no upper limit. Flag 0 sets no flag. A nonzero flag prevents execution when already set and is set before execution. Trigger phase and unit faction are separate.
turn_preview_scope: Turn events change for the chapters below. Existing scripts stay unchanged.
turn_new_help: The new group and its condition share one preview and history operation. Units, items, AI and map positions use the deployment editor.
game_invalid_event_conditions: The event condition pointer, record range or terminator is invalid. Other chapter settings remain editable.
area_scope: Edit area triggers in the general condition list. Area and objective views share one draft and are applied together. Map regions show effective bounds; existing scripts are preserved.
area_preview_scope: The complete general condition list changes for the chapters below, including pending area and objective edits. Existing scripts stay unchanged.
area_condition_help: Both endpoint cells are included. Coordinates are signed bytes. FE6/7 require ordered endpoints; FE8 accepts either order. Flag 0 allows repeat activation. A nonzero flag is checked and set before execution; choose an unused flag for a single activation.
area_empty: This version requires ordered endpoints. The current region cannot trigger.
area_repeats: Flag 0 allows this event to trigger again. Use an unused nonzero completion flag for a single activation.
talk_scope: Edit native talk conditions. New ordinary dialogues display an existing text ID. Recruitment, items and faction changes are defined by event scripts.
talk_preview_scope: Talk events change for the chapters below. Existing scripts stay unchanged.
talk_condition_help: Talk conditions are directional. FE6 matches both characters exactly; FE7/FE8 allow initiator 00 to match anyone. A nonzero completion flag blocks an event once set and is set before the script runs. FE7 modes 1/2 restrict the route; mode 3 requires the check flag. FE8 modes 1/2 disable the condition; mode 3 requires the check flag. Unknown values and unused bytes are preserved.
talk_repeat: Completion flag 0 allows this talk to repeat. Use an unused nonzero flag for a one-time dialogue.
talk_disabled_mode: This FE8 condition uses mode 1 or 2, which prevents it from triggering.
talk_text_help: Choose an existing text ID by hexadecimal ID or content. Text controls define speakers and portraits. Editing the text changes its other uses too.
objective_scope: Conditions are checked in their original order. Other victory entries and engine rules remain active. Area and objective views share one complete general-condition draft and are applied together.
objective_preview_scope: Append the complete general-condition table and update this pointer. Chapters sharing this pointer change together; independent pointers and existing scripts remain intact. Pending area and objective edits are applied together.
objective_flag_help: The completion flag is checked before the condition and set before the script starts; 0 permits repeats. Flag conditions require the trigger flag. FE6/7 read its low 16 bits; FE8 reads all 32 bits and accepts 0 or 0x64 unconditionally. FE6/7 treat 0 and 0x64 as false. Unknown bytes are retained.
objective_display_help: These text IDs edit the displayed wording. The list below edits actual general conditions. Tile events, turn events and engine rules may also complete or fail the chapter.
objective_boss_help: Requires a valid chapter-ending event. Add trigger flag 0x02 with completion flag 0x03 and link the existing ending. Flag 0x02 is set by defeat quotes or scripts; this does not assign a boss to a character.
objective_rout_help: Requires a valid chapter-ending event. FE8 uses trigger flag 0x06; FE7 and FE6 use their native callback. FE6 includes living green units in its check; FE7/8 check red units. Existing victory paths remain active.
objective_failure_help: Reuse this chapter's game-over event, or the native event when readable. Trigger flag defaults to 0x65 and can be changed. Existing death and engine failure rules remain active.
objective_zero_never: Trigger flag 0 never matches in FE6/7.
objective_zero_always: Trigger flag 0 matches unconditionally in FE8.
objective_script_help: Link an existing chapter event, the ending, game over, or the native flag-only marker. Script bytes remain intact. Completion flag 0x03 marks victory. The selected script retains its existing effects.
portrait_grid_help: 8 pixels per step; drag the outline to position
